name: Symbescaline
summary: Symbescaline (SB), also known as 3,5-diethoxy-4-methoxyphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of mescaline in which the methoxy groups at the 3 and 5 positions have been replaced with ethoxy groups. In addition, symbescaline is a positional isomer of asymbescaline.

uses.en: It is a rarely encountered research chemical with no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是一種罕見的研究用化學品，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种罕见的研究用化学品，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is mescaline with its two outer methoxy groups swapped for ethoxy groups, so the molecule stays symmetrical, which is where the sym in its name comes from. Alexander Shulgin described it in his book PiHKAL.
fact.zh: 它是把麥司卡林兩側的甲氧基換成乙氧基的產物，分子因此仍保持對稱，名稱中的sym即由此而來。亞歷山大．舒爾金在著作《PiHKAL》中描述過它。
fact.zhHans: 它是把麦司卡林两侧的甲氧基换成乙氧基的产物，分子因此仍保持对称，名称中的sym即由此而来。亚历山大．舒尔金在著作《PiHKAL》中描述过它。
